mentions.name: Housecat
mentions.description: Email inbox built to help users get real work done by connecting to services they use like Claude, Notion, Slack, CRM, and GitHub, making it easy to send messages and data between them directly from inside the inbox. Recently launched the email app in private beta.
mentions.problem: Busywork building up in the email inbox, with no way to act on work from within email.
mentions.source_excerpt: Housecat is the first email inbox that helps you get real work done. Our email connects to the other services you actually use like your Claude, Notion, Slack, CRM and Github and makes it easy to send messages and data between them.
mentions.author: thomas_housecat
